title: C4 Level 1 — System Context
description: Employees and Admin use the internal catalogue; developers supply information offline to employees.

title: C4 Level 2 — Containers
description: React calls the REST API, the API calls gRPC and SQL, and the Worker relays and consumes Redis work while SQL writes backup files.

title: Conceptual ERD — Business Catalogue
description: Developers own Projects; Units belong to Projects, Apartments also belong to Buildings, and Units have additional information and status changes.

title: Physical DB — Master Catalogue
description: Projects reference Developers and Buildings reference Projects; deletion is restricted.

title: Physical DB — Unit Location
description: Units reference Projects and Buildings with a same-Project composite constraint.

title: Physical DB — Details and Status History
description: UnitAttributes cascade on eligible Unit deletion; immutable history restricts Unit and actor deletion.

title: Physical DB — Bulk Creation
description: Accepted UnitBatches reference staff; created Units retain their originating Batch.

title: Physical DB — Project Summaries
description: Each ProjectSummary belongs to one Project and one SummaryRun.

title: Physical DB — Outbox and Backups
description: Outbox carries durable intent; BackupRuns store execution and retention state and optionally reference requesting staff.
